name: EIC Accelerator
summary: Grant and or equity for high-risk, high-potential SMEs and startups with breakthrough innovation. Natural persons may apply intending to set up an SME.
amount: Grant below EUR 2.5 million, and or equity of EUR 1 million to EUR 10 million, in grant-only, blended or equity-only options

deadline.note: Full proposal cut-offs in 2026: 7 Jan, 4 Mar, 6 May, 8 Jul, 2 Sep and 4 Nov (17:00 Brussels). Short proposals any time

next_steps: Read the official EIC Accelerator page and check the eligibility rules
Prepare a short proposal, which can be submitted at any time
Form an EU company before the full proposal stage if required

name: EIT Digital Venture Incubation Program (28DIGITAL)
provider: EIT Digital, part of the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT)
summary: A 12-week incubation for early-stage digital startups led by multidisciplinary teams, with a cash prize and a Demo Day.
amount: EUR 5,000 Growth Package prize at stage 1; stage 2 up to EUR 25,000 (see official page)

deadline.note: Yearly call. The 2026 call closed 9 June 2026 at 17:00 CET

next_steps: Watch the official page for the next yearly call
Form a team of at least two members
Check the incorporation date rule for the call

name: Erasmus for Young Entrepreneurs
provider: European Commission, Erasmus for Young Entrepreneurs programme
summary: A funded exchange in which a new or recently started entrepreneur works with an experienced entrepreneur running an SME in another participating country.
amount: Monthly travel and living support for a 1 to 6 month exchange; no fees to take part. Amounts: see official page
next_steps: Check the official page for the participating countries and eligibility
Plan a host entrepreneur match in a participating country
Apply through the programme website

name: EuroHPC AI Factories (access for SMEs and startups)
summary: Free customised support and access to EU AI computing for SMEs and startups, through the EU AI Factories network.
amount: Free access and support, value varies. See official page
next_steps: Read the access routes on the official page
Contact the AI Factories helpdesk to check establishment requirements
Describe the AI model work you need

name: Seedcamp
summary: Pre-seed and seed investor that backs companies from pre-product to early revenue, mainly in Europe and Israel or with a European angle. Not a formal cohort: starts with a call, then a 45 minute partner pitch. Not suited if you have already raised more than a couple of million dollars.
amount: First cheque usually USD 350,000 to USD 1.25M

deadline.note: No deadlines listed; aims to finish the process within two weeks of meeting a founder

next_steps: Use the Pitch Us link on the site
Prepare for an initial call and a 45 minute partner pitch
Confirm the European angle fits

name: Startup Wise Guys
summary: B2B startup accelerator with three stages (Building, Growing, Scaling) across seven verticals including SaaS, Fintech and Cybersecurity. Flagship initial ticket is EUR 100K. Equity, eligibility and application steps are not stated on the page.
amount: Initial ticket of EUR 100,000 in flagship programs
next_steps: Open the All programs page
Pick the program for your vertical
Confirm equity terms

name: EIT Health acceleration programmes
summary: Acceleration programmes for health innovators (Catapult, Start-ups Meet Pharma, Open Innovation) giving access to markets, funding and partners. All three show Closed for applications today; watch the New call opportunities page.

deadline.note: Closed today; watch for new calls

next_steps: Open the New call opportunities page
Watch for the next call

name: EIT Food Seedbed and Accelerator Network
summary: Programmes for agrifood startups (Seedbed, Accelerate and Tech Validation). A related Proof-of-Concept Co-Financing Instrument call to de-risk pilot projects lists a deadline of 30 November 2026. Terms of Seedbed and the Accelerator are not stated on the home page.

deadline.note: PoC Co-Financing call deadline 30 November 2026; other programs see the official page

next_steps: Open the Seedbed and Accelerate pages
Check the PoC Co-Financing call

name: Eurostars
provider: EUREKA network with national funding bodies and the European Commission
summary: International R&D funding for consortia led by an innovative SME; money comes from each partner's national funding body under national rules. Canada is a participating Eurostars country.
amount: Set per country by each national funding body; See the official page for the current round

deadline.note: Eurostars Call 12 deadline 4 March 2027; calls run about twice a year

next_steps: Find at least one independent partner from another Eurostars country, one from an EU or Horizon Europe associated country
Contact your national funding body for budget and rates
Keep the project civil only and 36 months or less

name: SME Fund (IP vouchers)
summary: Vouchers that reimburse EU SMEs for IP Scan and IP enforcement, trade mark and design applications, patents and plant varieties.
amount: IP Scan 90%; trade marks and designs up to 75%; patents up to 75%; plant varieties 75% (national caps apply)

deadline.note: The 2026 edition launched 2 Feb 2026; see the official page for the closing date

next_steps: Check your national IP office rules for caps
Apply for the voucher before filing the IP application
Keep invoices for reimbursement

name: EIT Jumpstarter
provider: EIT (European Institute of Innovation and Technology)
summary: Pre-acceleration programme where winners receive start-up funding and a travel budget. The page does not mention students; at least one team member must hold citizenship of a listed eligible country.
amount: EUR 2,500, EUR 5,000 or EUR 10,000 to winners, plus a travel budget (EUR 2,000 + EUR 1,000)

deadline.note: 2026 applications closed (due 17 May 2026 per the page). Next edition to be announced. See the official page for the current round

next_steps: Check that one team member holds citizenship of a listed country (Italy is listed; Canada and Australia are not)
Watch the site for the 2027 call
Prepare an idea summary and a team

name: Speedinvest
summary: Pan-European VC with offices in Berlin, London, Munich, Paris, Vienna and Abu Dhabi. Founders pitch through the Submit pitch Typeform on its Connect page; only shortlisted companies are contacted. Stage and cheque sizes are not stated on the page.

deadline.note: Open form; only shortlisted companies are contacted

next_steps: Open the Connect page
Complete the Submit pitch application
Pick the thematic team that fits

name: Cherry Ventures
summary: Early-stage VC backing European founders. Investment inquiries go to opportunity@cherry.vc. Stage and cheque sizes are not stated on the page read.
next_steps: Read the What we look for section
Email opportunity@cherry.vc with a short summary and deck
Confirm stage fit
